sources.title: Ornith-1.5-9B-OBLITERATED: Text-to-Text model - aimodels.fyi
sources.snippet: Overview Ornith-1.5-9B-OBLITERATED is a weight-edited, uncensored text-generation model from OBLITERATUS, based on Ornith-1.5-9B. It has 9 billion parameters and uses a Qwen3.5 hybrid architecture that combines Gated DeltaNet with full attention across 32 transformer layers. sources.title: Ornith-1.5: From Self-Scaffolding to Self-Improvement
sources.snippet: Ornith-1.5 extends the self-scaffolding framework introduced in Ornith-1.0 into a more complete self-improvement loop: the model proposes new tasks, generates task-specific scaffolds, and produces solution rollouts for reinforcement learning, continuously creating new learning experiences from which it can improve.
